title: Temperature pair
prompt: Implement `static double CtoF(double c)` (multiply by 9/5, add 32) and `static double FtoC(double f)` (subtract 32, multiply by 5/9). Watch the parentheses — the subtraction must happen before the scaling in one direction and after it in the other.

tests.name: boiling
tests.hint: The two fixed points of the scale.

tests.name: freezing-and-roundtrip
tests.hint: Freezing point both ways, then FtoC(CtoF(x)) must land back on x.
